title: OpenCode Config Composer settings
description: Shared source directories, agent groups, model presets, and prompt composition settings. Save as config-composer.jsonc in the OpenCode configuration directory, or select a custom file with the server plugin's configFile option.

$schema.description: Schema path or URL that editors use to validate this settings file and show configuration hints.

sourceDirectories.description: Composer aliases. Paths resolve from the settings file. Independent of OpenCode references.

propertyNames.description: Source alias used in @source/path references and include directives.

additionalProperties.description: Source directory path. Relative paths resolve from the settings file. A leading ~/ expands to home.

not.description: Source directory paths must not contain NUL characters.

agent.description: Agent group defaults, reusable model choices, and prompt composition policies.

groups.description: Named groups selected by agent memberships. Later groups override earlier model and variant fields.

propertyNames.description: Group name used in an agent's ordered groups array.

additionalProperties.description: Model defaults and prompt layers for agents that belong to this group.

modelPresets.description: Named model choices that groups can select with preset:<name> model references.

propertyNames.description: Preset name used after preset: in a model reference.

additionalProperties.description: Concrete model and optional variant shared by groups that reference this preset.

prompts.description: Prompt layers for enabled agents with authored prompts. Layer order is defaults, groups, then overrides.

defaults.description: Shared prompt layers applied unless an agent sets inheritDefaults to false.

overrides.description: Prompt layers and inheritance controls keyed by the exact configured agent name.

propertyNames.description: Exact agent name whose prompt composition settings this entry controls.

additionalProperties.description: Additional prompt layers and inheritance controls for this agent.

command.description: Reserved for command settings. Leave empty.

skill.description: Reserved; leave empty. Native skill body includes use sourceDirectories.

name.description: Alias, group, or preset name. Use lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens. Start with a letter.

not.description: Names must not equal constructor or prototype.

model.description: Concrete model ID in provider/model format, without whitespace.

agentName.description: Configured agent name, including slash-separated names. Whitespace and backslashes are not allowed.

not.description: Agent name segments must not equal ., .., __proto__, constructor, or prototype.

variant.description: Variant supported by the model. Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens.

modelRef.description: Reference to opencode:model, opencode:small_model, or a configured preset through preset:<name>.

anyOf.description: Reference to OpenCode's configured default model or small model.
Reference to an existing entry in agent.modelPresets, using preset:<name>.

not.description: Preset references must not use constructor or prototype as the preset name.

promptParts.description: Ordered prompt fragments. Each layer supports up to 256 strings and expands Composer includes.

items.description: Literal text, an @source/path.md or .txt reference, or text containing {{include:@source/path.md}}.

prompt.description: Prompt fragments inserted before and after an agent's authored prompt.

prepend.description: Fragments inserted before the authored prompt, preserving array order.

append.description: Fragments inserted after the authored prompt, preserving array order.

agentPrompt.description: Per-agent prompt layers and controls for inheriting default and group prompt layers.

prepend.description: Agent-specific fragments placed after inherited prepends and before the authored prompt.

append.description: Agent-specific fragments placed after the authored prompt and inherited appends.

inheritDefaults.description: Include default prompt layers unless false. Omission enables prompt inheritance. Models are unaffected.

inheritGroups.description: Include group prompt layers unless false, in membership order. Omission enables prompt inheritance.

preset.description: Reusable concrete model choice with an optional model variant.

model.description: Required concrete model selected by this preset.

variant.description: Optional model variant inherited unless a group or agent specifies its own variant.

group.description: Model defaults and prompt layers for a named group. Agents with explicit models retain those models.

model.description: Concrete default model for this group. Specify either model or modelRef.

modelRef.description: Model reference for this group. Specify either modelRef or model.

variant.description: Model variant that overrides a referenced preset's variant. Requires model or modelRef.

prompt.description: Group prompt layers applied in membership order unless an agent sets inheritGroups to false.

not.description: A group must not specify both a concrete model and a model reference.

if.description: Detect whether the group specifies a model variant.

then.description: A group variant requires either a concrete model or a model reference.

anyOf.description: A concrete model supplies the group variant's model.
A model reference supplies the group variant's model.
